question: Shifa can do a certain piece of work in 30 days. Shifa and Afiya can together do the same work in 18 days, and Shifa, Afrya and Mariyam can do the same work together in 9 days. In how many days can Shifa and Mariyam do the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

Shifa alone can do the work in 30 days

Shifa and Afiya together can do the work in 18 days

Shifa, Afiya and Mariyam together can do the work in 9 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Rate × Time

Individual rate = Combined rate − Other rates

**Calculation:**

⇒ Rate of Shifa = 1 ÷ 30

⇒ Rate of Shifa and Afiya = 1 ÷ 18

⇒ Rate of Afiya = 1 ÷ 18 &am
